That A.A. section lists 6 required courses (CINEMA 105, CINEMA 107, MEDIART 100, MEDIART 104, MEDIART 105, MEDIART 116), then 1 course from CINEMA 101 or MEDIART 101. It prints Major Units: 21 and Total Minimum Units: 60.

The certificate sections run alphabetically (Cinematography, Core Studies, Directing, Editing and Color Grading, Producing, Screenwriting, Sound Design).
